scenarios.name: the opportunity travels between nodes
lawsProved: the privacy gate runs FIRST: a private record never touches the wire (no envelope, no trace)
the generalized projection travels — never the private intent; received records stay conditional by law (INV-30)
node B matches the received opportunity against ITS OWN user's intent (a pure read — never a reservation or a purchase)

nodeBMatchForOwnUser.matchBasis: family group_buy_threshold is one of the eight contract counterfactual families; the projection is active and same-currency (HKD); budget band: compatible (the projected band fits the stated budget). A match NEVER reserves, buys, publishes, messages, or authorizes anything (issue #23 W2 law).
